**Role Overview**
DRC Systems is seeking an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with business and project stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle. You will understand business needs, define and document clear requirements, and help technical teams deliver solutions that meet those needs. As a key link between business and technology, you will clarify expectations, identify gaps and dependencies, and keep stakeholders aligned as requirements evolve.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Partner with business users, clients, product owners, project managers, and technical teams to understand business goals and project needs.
* Plan and lead requirements activities, including interviews, workshops, discovery sessions, and process reviews.
* Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, use cases, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Document current and future state processes, business rules, functional requirements, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Validate requirements with stakeholders and maintain traceability as they change through the project lifecycle.
* Act as the day-to-day link between business and technical teams, clarifying requirements and resolving questions promptly.
* Collaborate with design, engineering, and QA teams to support solution design, development, and testing.
* Review proposed solutions and deliverables to confirm they meet agreed business requirements.
* Support user acceptance testing by preparing scenarios, coordinating feedback, tracking issues, and helping stakeholders validate outcomes.
* Identify requirement gaps, risks, scope changes, and process improvement opportunities; communicate them to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate project documentation, decisions, and action items; contribute to planning and estimation by clarifying scope, complexity, and dependencies.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4–5 years of experience in a Business Analyst role, preferably in software delivery, IT services, or technology-enabled projects.
* Experience managing requirements from discovery through documentation, delivery, and validation.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the confidence to work effectively with business users and technical teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain complex topics in straightforward language.
* A structured approach to analysis, attention to detail, and the ability to distinguish requirements from assumptions.
* Experience creating business requirements documents, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and test scenarios.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, adapt to changing requirements, and keep stakeholders aligned.
* A collaborative and accountable approach, with the judgment to raise questions and risks early.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with Agile or Scrum delivery, as well as traditional project approaches.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Visio, Miro, or similar platforms.
* Exposure to process mapping, backlog refinement, UAT coordination, and change management.
* Relevant degree or equivalent practical experience.

title: Consultant / Sr. Consultant - Energy Transition & Sustainability Strategy
description:
**About Pravi**

Pravi is a strategy and policy consulting firm that helps governments, institutions and businesses move from intent to implementation. Our work spans strategy, policy design, digital transformation and data-led decision-making, with a focus on outcomes that can be measured on the ground.

**Why this Role**

India is in the middle of one of the largest energy transitions in the world. Decisions being taken now on storage, renewables, energy efficiency, clean fuels and carbon markets will shape how the country produces and uses energy for decades. You will help shape policies, programmes and implement them in renewable energy, energy storage, energy efficiency, carbon markets and clean fuels. You will assist in research of what works, support decisions, set up the systems that put those decisions into action, and work directly with senior officials and industry leaders.

**Key focus areas**

* Energy efficiency and conservation: BEE programmes and their implementation, including PAT, CCTS, ECBC, Standards and Labelling, and Demand Side Management
* Renewable and alternative energy: Solar, wind and hybrid systems, grid integration and power system fundamentals, renewable purchase and consumption obligations (RPO/RCO)
* Energy storage: Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and other storage technologies ○ Carbon markets and decarbonisation: carbon credit mechanisms, MRV, climate mitigation interventions and decarbonisation pathways
* Biogas and alternative fuels: Compressed Biogas (CBG), associated technologies and other clean fuels
* Waste and circular economy: waste management, and recycling and circular management of renewable energy equipment
* Climate change and emerging areas: sectoral implications of climate change, clean technologies and other emerging areas in the energy transition

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Research and Policy Assistance

* Undertake research and analysis across the focus areas to support decision-making
* Review existing policies and programmes to identify gaps requiring policy, regulatory or implementation interventions
* Draft issue notes, analytical briefs, policy documents, technical studies, background material and presentations
* Examine documents and matters requiring technical inputs, and prepare technical notes, comments and responses

2. Programme Design, Implementation and Management

* Translate climate and energy priorities into actionable plans, and support them through preparation, review and implementation
* Support the roll-out of policies, programmes and facilitation services, from design to day-to-day operations
* Support the setup, staffing and operation of dedicated cells of work areas, including RPO/RCO mechanisms and carbon credit facilitation
* Support the implementation of BEE schemes and initiatives under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001
* Assist in Demand Side Management programmes, management of energy conservation funds, PAT/CCTS processes and monitoring of renewable consumption obligations
* Monitor programme progress, consolidate information, and follow up on activities and action points
* Prepare periodic reports and submissions in prescribed formats and timelines
* Help conceptualise, develop, integrate and manage digital portals and platforms

3. Stakeholder Engagement and Coordination

* Coordinate with government departments, central ministries and agencies, industry associations, developers, manufacturers, financial institutions, international organisations, universities, research bodies and knowledge partners
* Manage meetings and consultations end to end: agendas, presentations, invitations, background material and data collection formats
* Record discussions, prepare Minutes of Meeting and track follow-up actions

4. Capacity Building and Knowledge Management

* Develop learning resources such as reference materials, knowledge toolkits, training content and print material, tailored to the stakeholder needs
* Plan and conduct training programmes, workshops and other learning sessions for stakeholders

**Required experience and skills**

● 4 to 10 years of experience in energy, power, climate, renewable, policy research, CSR or consulting sector

● Working knowledge of at least two of the focus areas listed above

● Understanding of power systems and renewable energy fundamentals

● Familiarity with BEE norms and energy efficiency programmes

● Strong research, analytical and report-writing skills

● Good presentation skills and proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint / Canva

● Experience engaging with senior stakeholders in government, industry or institutions

**Good to have**

● Experience with consulting firms, development organisations, think tanks, research institutions, or energy and sustainability companies

● BEE Certified Energy Auditor or Energy Manager certification

● Exposure to carbon markets, CBG or BESS projects

● Experience designing or managing CSR programmes

● Proficiency in Gujarati Language

**Who we are looking for**

You will do well in this role if you:

● Enjoy building a deep understanding of a subject and can explain it simply to others

● Structure your thinking before you write or speak, and communicate it clearly

● Question assumptions, including your own, and form views backed by evidence

● Are comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and standing by your recommendations

● Take full ownership of your work, from the first draft to final delivery

● Are eager to learn new domains and stay confident when the path is not clearly defined

What can you expect from this role?

● Work on live energy transition projects with real implementation outcomes

● Direct exposure to senior decision-makers from early in your career

● Ownership of deliverables, not just support tasks

● Learning across multiple domains in a single versatile role

● A team where good work is always noticed and rewarded

title: Assistant Manager - PPC
description:
**About the Company**

Experiences fueled by innovations, forward thinking, and a commitment to bring the very best to Indian roads. From the day the iconic Maruti 800 was launched in 1983, the company has been spearheading a revolution of change. Turning an entire country’s need for driving, into its love for driving. However, tastes and demands keep on evolving with each new generation of Indians. This has not been looked at by Maruti Suzuki as a challenge, but as an inspiration to go beyond traditional boundaries of car-making. Infusing design and technology is one such step it has taken to make its cars meet new age expectations smoothly.Maruti Suzuki India Limited, BU Hansalpur plant is a subsidiary of Maruti Suzuki India Limited to produce automobiles from Gujarat, was established in March 2014, aiming to secure production ability in preparation for the automobile market growth in India, as well as for expansion of exports from India. In MSIL – BU Hansalpur, Plant A started operating from February 2017, subsequently Plant B, Powertrain Plant started in January 2019. In October 2020, MSIL-BU Hansalpur became the fastest production site of Maruti Suzuki to achieve accumulated automobile production of 1 million units. MSIL – Hansalpur is also home of Maruti Suzuki’s prestigious e-Vitara, the first EV of Maruti Suzuki in world. The plant proudly exported the e-Vitara to more than 165 countries so far. Today, Maruti Suzuki has its eyes set firmly on the possibilities of tomorrow.

**About the Role**

Responsible for material planning and inventory management by analyzing production plans, generating MRP, and ensuring timely material availability to support uninterrupted production. Coordinates with vendors and cross-functional teams to manage schedules, monitor deliveries, control inventory as per JIT principles, and address supply risks. * Issue Material Schedules to vendors based on daily, weekly, fortnightly, and monthly forecasts.
* Coordinate with Purchaser, Stores and Production teams to align material availability with production Plan.
* Track Material Delivery schedules to ensure timely supply and escalate delays.
* Maintain Inventory levels as per just-in-time (JIT) principles; avoid excess stock and line shortages.
* Monitor consumption trends and revise orders as per real-time production changes.
* Coordinate for Engineering Change Notes (ECNs) and update material planning accordingly.
* Generate reports on ordering status, delivery adherence, shortages, and risks.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* BE/B. Tech in Mechanical/Automobile Engineering from reputed college
* Overall, 60% in BE/B. Tech, 10th & 12th
* 02 to 06 years of experience preferably in Auto ancillary Industries

**Required Skills**

* Understanding of supply chain/logistics principles.
* Working knowledge of MRP, ERP/SAP systems.
* Knowledge of production processes and BOMs.
* Strong analytical and planning skills.
* Proactive communication and coordination abilities.

**Preferred Skills**

* Automotive Manufacturing Process Knowledge
* Power BI / Advanced Excel Reporting

title: Industrial Engineering Supervisor
description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
Analog Devices is seeking an experienced Industrial Engineer to join the Central Industrial Engineering team. This role will lead high-impact initiatives focused on capacity modeling, factory scheduling, cycle time reduction, operations research, and productivity improvement across ADI's front-end manufacturing network. The successful candidate will drive development of cross-site analytical models, optimization tools, and data-driven decision systems that maximize factory output, support expansion planning, and establish standardized Industrial Engineering practices across multiple manufacturing sites.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead development of cross-site capacity models, utilization analyses, loading scenarios, and expansion planning studies.
* Drive cycle time reduction and WIP optimization initiatives through Factory Physics methodologies, bottleneck analysis, and constraint management.
* Develop and maintain advanced analytical tools supporting factory scheduling, output optimization, and operational decision making.
* Perform operations research and statistical analyses to identify key output levers and productivity improvement opportunities.
* Design and implement predictive models, optimization algorithms, and AI-enabled analytical solutions for manufacturing applications.
* Lead validation and continuous improvement of scheduling logic, factory planning assumptions, and manufacturing data structures.

title: Manager - Process Excellence & Cost Optimization
description:
**Job Purpose**
This role controls plant cost and material loss and improves workforce productivity. It does this through standard measurement systems (BOM, cost per sq ft, manpower matrices) and shop-floor automation such as production scanning, smart scheduling and live dashboards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Cost and Financial Control**

* Track monthly plant cost per sq ft against budget, and analyse and explain variances.
* Reconcile BB and COV material consumption and wastage against BOM, keeping variance within 1%.
* Build and maintain a BOM-based tracking system for general consumables, with cost variance within 5%.
* Reconcile and approve job-worker bills within the agreed billing cycle, with no delays.

**Automation and Digital Tracking**

* Implement operator-wise and team-wise production scanning (barcode for COV, QR code for BB) to measure throughput and reduce manpower cost by 10% YoY.
* Drive smart production scheduling and order-kit allocation to improve direct-worker efficiency by 20%.
* Develop an AI / Power BI tracker for media-wise material inflow versus wastage, with full traceability and variance under 1%.
* Maintain daily plant and department dashboards comparing budget and actual cost trends.

**Waste Management and Manpower Productivity**

* Develop at least two alternate or backup buyers for each saleable scrap item or category, targeting a 15% impact on sale value.
* Optimise waste disposal, including balers for cardboard, plastic and fabric, to cut waste volume by 30%.
* Build a manpower performance measurement matrix for non-sq-ft production and non-production departments.
* Support the skill matrix and skill-based operator allocation, and train supervisors and operators in method and productivity improvement (10 people per department).

**General Duties**

* Conduct time and motion studies, set standard times, and balance lines.
* Prepare monthly MIS and variance reports for management.
* Coordinate with production, stores, finance, IT and vendors.
* Lead Lean, Kaizen and 5S initiatives.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Industrial, Mechanical or Production Engineering. An MBA or PGDIE is preferred.
* 8–12 years in manufacturing industrial engineering, costing or productivity, including at least 3 years leading projects or a team.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong in BOM and inventory reconciliation, cost analysis, time study and production scheduling.
* Skilled in advanced Excel and Power BI, with exposure to ERP/MES and barcode or QR systems. AI or analytics knowledge is a plus.
* Analytical, detail-oriented and comfortable presenting data to senior management.
* Able to work across departments and train shop-floor teams.

title: Deputy Manager - Material Planning
description:
**Deputy Manager – Material Planning**
Group Bayport | Supply Chain Management | Gandhinagar, Gujarat
  
  
**About Group Bayport**
Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e-Commerce B2B2C, B2B and B2C organisation that has re-defined the business of delivering high-quality custom products through a unique blend of innovative digital technologies, robust manufacturing capabilities, and a global supply chain. An industry leader in print technology, Group Bayport operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the UK, and India through its family of brands — Banner Buzz, Covers & All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media and Neon Earth.
  
  
From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages and shades, to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients and partners make a personalised statement through customisation.
  
  
While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1,450+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.
  
  
Learn more: https://groupbayport.com/about-us/
  
  
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an analytical and initiative-taking Deputy Manager – Material Planning to own material planning for a defined set of brands and strategic accounts.
  
  
Group Bayport operates a predominantly made-to-order custom manufacturing model across a high-SKU environment. That makes material planning the difference between an order shipping on time and a production line standing idle. The role is accountable for having the right materials available when production needs them, for holding inventory at the agreed norms, and for working closely with Procurement, Production Planning and Operations so that plans translate into actual availability on the floor.
  
  
**Position details**
Designation: Deputy Manager – Material Planning
  
  
Function: Supply Chain Management – Centralised Material Planning
  
  
Reporting to: Deputy General Manager – Supply Chain Planning
  
  
Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat
  
  
Experience: 6 – 10 years
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Planning ownership**

* Own the material plan end to end for assigned brands and strategic accounts.
* Build material requirement plans from sales orders, customer forecasts, and production schedules.
* Convert requirements into purchase requisitions and release them to Procurement with the correct priority and timing.
* Maintain planning parameters in the ERP — reorder levels, safety stock, lead times, and material master data.

**Material availability and risk**

* Ensure availability of all production inputs — textiles, printing media, inks, hardware, packaging, and consumables.
* Review material availability against the production plan daily and flag risks before they affect output.
* Track supplier lead times and escalate slippage to Procurement early enough to act on it.
* Identify shortages and build contingency plans — alternate material, alternate source, or re-sequencing with Production Planning.

**Inventory management**

* Hold inventory at agreed norms — neither short nor in excess.
* Analyse consumption trends and recommend stocking strategy for fast-moving and critical materials.
* Review inventory ageing and slow-moving or non-moving stock and drive corrective action.
* Lead inventory optimisation initiatives without compromising service levels.

**Coordination and reporting**

* Work closely with Sales, Production Planning, Procurement, Stores and Operations to ensure seamless material flow.
* Participate in the S&OP cycle and support demand planning.
* Publish daily, weekly, and monthly planning reports and KPIs.
* Improve planning processes through data analysis and better use of the ERP.

**Scope boundary**
This role plans, triggers and tracks material requirements. Purchase order placement, supplier negotiation and vendor follow-up sit with Procurement. The planner is accountable for raising the right requirement at the right time and for escalating risk; Procurement is accountable for the buy.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like In The First 90 Days**

* Material plans running for all assigned accounts without manual workarounds.
* A daily, published view of which materials are at risk and what is being done about them.
* Planning parameters in the ERP accurate, complete, and actively maintained.
* At least one measurable inventory improvement delivered and evidenced.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Material availability for production (%)
* Production stoppages attributable to material shortage
* Inventory turns and inventory days of cover.
* Inventory record accuracy.
* Excess, slow-moving and obsolete inventory as a percentage of total.
* Planning accuracy — requirement plan against actual consumption
* Purchase requisitions raised on or before the planned date
* Inventory carrying cost.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA or PGDM in Operations or Supply Chain Management preferred.

**Experience**

* 6 to 10 years in material planning, production planning, supply chain, or inventory management.
* Manufacturing background preferred — signage, printing, textiles, packaging or similar.
* Experience in a high-SKU or made-to-order environment is a strong advantage.
* Experience planning across multiple brands or business lines is an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of Material Requirement Planning (MRP).
* Firsthand experience with an ERP system — SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or equivalent.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel — pivot tables, lookup functions, dashboards, and modelling.
* Comfortable analysing consumption patterns and demand data to reach a recommendation.

**Competencies**

* Analytical, with a bias for working from data rather than assumption.
* Organised, and able to carry several priorities without dropping any of them.
* Communicates clearly across functions and manages stakeholders well.
* Takes ownership of outcomes rather than of tasks.
* Strong diligence and comfortable working at pace.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* Signage manufacturing
* Digital and large format printing
* Textile manufacturing
* Packaging
* Custom or made-to-order manufacturing

 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 Product Data Services or Security Master Team is responsible for setting up Fixed Income securities like Corporate Bonds, Municipal Bonds, Mortgage Back Securities, and Treasuries etc. on the back\-office systems to facilitate the trades to flow into various upstream and downstream systems across the Enterprise. Team also maintains the Fixed Income securities with updating the latest rates, factor, prices and ratings information to facilitate correct interest and principal calculations in the downstream accounting systems.
   

  

 Product Data Services process on legacy Merrill Lynch side does similar functions for Equity and equity related products like common stock, preferred, warrants, rights, equity options etc.
   

  

**Job Description**
 PDS/Security Master business provides associates a unique opportunity to learn and build hands on understanding of various asset classes ex; Fixed Income, Equities, Futures and Options traded globally. It provides the candidates a flavor of what attributes are required to build an instrument and ongoing amendments to facilitate various process across the bank to operate seamlessly. These instruments are required to be updated at various stages of the trade flow.
   

  

 The associates are expected to maintain good turnaround time and accuracy across all the set\-ups, rates and factor updates. Associates are expected to understand the security types and system capabilities to ensure smooth trade flow from front office to back office systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Setup and maintenance of Securities – Debt and Equity
* Use vendor databases – Bloomberg and IDSI to pull up security details for security set\-up or update.
* Setting up the Security per vendor database and responding to requestor within specified Turn Around Time
* Perform daily, weekly and monthly tasks on rates and factor updates for variable rate and factored bonds. Research on vendor databases for this information
* Perform self\-review of data input in the back\-office systems. Ensure secondary reviews for such data are performed by the assigned reviewer in the process
* Strong analytical, verbal and written communication skills
* Must be quick learner to adapt to new systems and procedural change
* Ability to perform in a periodically changing process
* Comfortable to work in multiple systems at the same time
* Eye for detail and must be procedure focused to adhere to the Policy guidelines.
* Excellent organizational skills are required with the ability to prioritize workload, work accurately and efficiently under pressure.
* To be flexible in their attitude and approach; have a strong desire to learn from day to day scenarios.


**Requirements**
**Education** 
 – Graduate and Preferably MBA
   

  

* Certifications If Any – NCFM

**Foundational Skills**
* Hands on understanding of Global Markets business and Product Data Services
* Strong analytical, verbal and written communication skills
* Attention for detail and must be quick learner to adapt to new systems/procedural change


**Desired Skills**
* Hands on understanding of Process Controls
* Strong understanding of all asset classes
